Razorpay self-test (test_payments_flow.py) re-run with temporarily injected dummy keys: bad-sig→400, good-sig→200+wallet credited +₹1500 idempotently (replay=already_processed, no double credit), GST invoice PDF downloads (application/pdf, %PDF- header, 3394 bytes). .env restored to empty Razorpay keys afterward — confirmed /payments/config.configured=false again. Password reset cycle verified end-to-end (request never leaks, token hashed in DB with TTL expires_at, email_log=log_only since Resend/SMTP empty, invalid+expired→400, valid→200, password restored to Acme@12345 and admin login still works). Document upload falls back to local disk (storage_provider='local'), super_admin upload blocked with 403, tenant-scoped download+list work. core.messaging._norm normalizes +91/10-digit/12-digit/with-spaces correctly, rejects invalid; send_critical_alert returns all phones in 'skipped' with whatsapp=[] sms=[] when WA+MSG91 unconfigured (graceful degradation confirmed, no exceptions). DB indexes verified: payment_orders.order_id unique, messaging_log & email_log index_information non-empty.

action_items: NONE — Phase-6 backend is production-ready. User needs to populate the following env keys in /app/backend/.env when ready to go live: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY (or SMTP_HOST+USER+PASSWORD), WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID+WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN (+ MSG91_AUTHKEY+sender+template ids), R2_ACCOUNT_ID+R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID+R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY+R2_BUCKET. Code already fail-safe when any are empty.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: HMAC-SHA256 verification uses hmac.compare_digest (constant-time, prevents timing attacks). Good.
payments._finalize_payment is idempotent via po.status check and unique gst_invoice_no collision-rename loop — double credit prevented even under webhook+verify race.
payments.verify enforces tenant scope (po.client_id != user.client_id → 403) BEFORE signature check. Correct RBAC ordering.
auth.py password_reset_request always returns 200 regardless of email existence — no user enumeration leak. Token is stored sha256 hashed, raw token only appears in URL sent via email.
auth.py password_reset_confirm correctly handles expires_at that could be either datetime or ISO string (legacy). Timezone normalization present.
storage.py gracefully falls back to local disk on R2 failure OR when R2 not configured — single code path, same return shape (provider/key/location/size). Clean abstraction.
messaging.py send_critical_alert never raises — all errors captured into 'skipped' with reason. messaging_log writes wrapped in try/except.
documents.upload has size guard (MAX_UPLOAD_MB default 25) that reads in 1MB chunks and raises 413 before buffering entire file — good memory protection.
emailer.py cascades Resend → SMTP → log-only; every attempt recorded in email_log with provider+success. Non-blocking via asyncio.to_thread for sync SMTP/Resend calls.

CONFIG OBSERVATION: SSPL_GSTIN='__PLACEHOLDER_GSTIN__' and SSPL_PAN='__PLACEHOLDER_PAN__' in .env — acceptable placeholders; main agent should flag these for user to fill before go-live since they render on tax invoice PDF.
MINOR: wallet_balance float arithmetic in tests compared with tolerance 0.01 — for production fintech recommend Decimal, but acceptable for MVP. (Not a bug, future enhancement.)
MINOR: /api/payments/webhook does not verify tenant/client scope post-signature since Razorpay payload is trusted-by-signature — standard practice.
